top_creatures.label: Scale tyrant
top_creatures.why: Boss footprint (collision size 300) is about 2.4 times the next boss value (125); walk 50 then run 186 gives a charge at about 3.7 times walk speed
top_creatures.keep: huge footprint and the walk-then-charge contrast
top_creatures.change: own silhouette and sound; fight split across zones rather than one pad

top_creatures.label: Ring-reach colossus
top_creatures.why: Widest reach of any boss in the file (radius 140, size 75, HP 90000, level 50)
top_creatures.change: reach drawn as a ground ring telegraph (idea only; not in the data)

top_creatures.label: Armed boss
top_creatures.why: Equipped weapon id 1472 and walk 100, the fastest walk of any boss; run 230
top_creatures.keep: a boss whose attack is tied to a held weapon
top_creatures.ref: NodeL2-NodeL2/data/Npcs/npcs.json selfId 12055; weapon id 1472 in data/Items/Weapons/weapons.json (not opened by row)

top_creatures.label: Melee and ranged rank pair
top_creatures.why: Same family, similar body HP (399 vs 429), ranged rank attack about 2.4 times the melee rank (25 vs 61)
top_creatures.keep: same HP band, higher attack for the ranged rank

top_creatures.label: Stepped rank ladder
top_creatures.why: Eight ranks: HP +28% and attack +76% from the first rank to the last; collision size steps from 12 to 17
top_creatures.keep: rank names and size steps as visible progression
top_creatures.change: add one visible trait per rank, since the stats alone are a shallow ramp
top_creatures.ref: NodeL2-NodeL2/data/Npcs/npcs.json line 817 onward (Ant Larva to Ant Warrior Captain)

top_creatures.label: Lettered pet line
top_creatures.why: Nine-letter variant families (A to I) for several summon lines, so one template yields many looks
top_creatures.keep: a letter-variant set per pet line
top_creatures.change: name variants by role instead of by letter

top_creatures.label: Pack sprinter
top_creatures.why: Run speed 230 (the file's top run value) on mid-level records 12004 (level 37) and 12005 (level 39), and on the boss 12001
top_creatures.keep: fast run speed as a flanker role

top_creatures.label: Lumbering queen
top_creatures.why: Large HP pool (60000 at level 43) on a fast-running body (walk 80, run 230)
top_creatures.keep: heavy HP with fast swarm speed
top_creatures.change: brood spawns in rings (behaviour not read in this box)

looks.label: Breath countdown bar
looks.technique: a timed duration bar of 86 seconds that starts when the depth gate trips and clears on leaving

looks.label: Hit or miss flag
looks.technique: one byte in the attack packet says hit or miss, so each outcome can play its own impact cue

looks.label: Stand-up after revive
looks.technique: a stand-up social action after a 2.5-second delay, so a death reads as a pause

looks.label: Corpse time
looks.technique: a fixed corpse window (7,000 ms in the sampled records) before it clears

looks.label: Skill wind-up per row
looks.technique: hit time, reuse and buff time per active skill, so each attack has a visible beat
